package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
)

func TestBuildLessonMaterialsResponseHidesAnswersAndUsesEmptyArrays(t *testing.T) {
	correctOrder := 1
	result := buildLessonMaterialsResponse(&lesson.LessonMaterials{
		Lesson: map[string]any{"id": "lesson-id"},
		Tasks: []lesson.LessonMaterialTask{{
			Task: domain.Task{ID: "task-id", Status: domain.TaskStatusActive},
			Tests: []domain.TaskTest{{
				ID: "test-id",
				Variants: []domain.TaskTestVariant{{
					ID:             "variant-id",
					IsCorrect:      true,
					CorrectOrder:   &correctOrder,
					GroupID:        "group-id",
					GroupSourceKey: "group-key",
				}},
			}},
		}},
		RelatedLessons: []lesson.RelatedLessonMaterial{{
			Relation: domain.LessonRelation{ID: "relation-id"},
			Lesson:   map[string]any{"id": "related-lesson-id"},
		}},
	})

	payload, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal response: %v", err)
	}
	text := string(payload)
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"is_correct", "correct_order", "group_id", "group_source_key"} {
		if strings.Contains(text, forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("public response leaked %s: %s", forbidden, text)
		}
	}
	if !strings.Contains(text, `"examples":[]`) || !strings.Contains(text, `"related_examples":[]`) {
		t.Fatalf("empty collections must be JSON arrays: %s", text)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(text, `"access_context":{"kind":"lesson_relation","relation_id":"relation-id"}`) {
		t.Fatalf("related lesson access context is missing: %s", text)
	}
	if len(result.Tasks) != 1 || len(result.Tasks[0].Tests) != 1 || len(result.Tasks[0].Tests[0].Variants) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("public task/test structure was not retained: %#v", result.Tasks)
	}
}
